note: Categories not yet in taxonomy.json. To adopt one, add it to taxonomy.json and re-run the categorization; its members in `other` are retried automatically. source: `agent` = suggested by a categorization batch, `review` = spotted when reviewing the `other` bucket.

candidates.reason: Parse and serialize HTTP headers: cookies, content type, content negotiation, ranges, caching validators.
Strip, wrap, slice or pad strings that contain ANSI codes. Could instead be merged into terminal-string-width.
One-shot probes of the runtime environment: CI, Docker, WSL, color support, interactivity.
Expand bash-style braces and numeric or alpha ranges.
http.Agent implementations and proxy agents.
Small server-side HTTP helpers: error objects, content-type checks, final responders.
Read and parse a request body from a stream.
Static file serving with range and conditional-GET support.
Build, merge or convert source maps while editing code.
LRU caches, key-value stores, linked lists and queues. Probably two categories: caches and queues.
Filesystem wrappers: recursive mkdir and remove, atomic writes, JSON files, temp files. Mixed tasks; mkdir (mkdirp, make-dir) is the cleanest sub-class.
Watch a directory tree and report changes.
In-memory path string utilities: normalize slashes, parse, test containment.
Test whether a string is a glob, or extract its static parent.
Domain name encoding (Punycode, IDNA/UTS46).
Decode data: URLs into bytes or a parsed MIME type and body.
Small string transforms: camelCase, decamelize, RegExp and JS string escaping.
Wrap a function so it runs only once.
Promise implementations, promisification and retry helpers. Retry is the cleanest sub-class.
Find the calling file or parent module from the stack trace.
Intercept module loading.
Emit cursor and other ANSI control sequences.
Interactive prompts, spinners and progress bars. Needs scripted stdin; prompts and progress are probably separate categories.
Runtime value type predicates.
Markdown parsing and syntax-tree processing.
Parse and stringify space- or comma-separated attribute token lists.
Parse, format and do arithmetic on dates.
Build a className string from conditional inputs.
Levenshtein edit distance between two strings.
Compute a line or character diff between two texts.
Map file extensions to MIME types and back.
Parse, validate and match IPv4 and IPv6 addresses and CIDR ranges.
Parse CSS selectors into an AST. Could instead be merged into css-parsing.
Client state stores and immutable updates. Loose equivalence; needs a careful task definition.
Decode and encode byte buffers in legacy character encodings, or detect the encoding.
Base64 and low-level binary number encoding.
Pipe streams together and detect completion or errors.
Read, locate and normalize package.json or tsconfig files.
d3 modules with no peers in the list. Different tasks, so not one category; listed so they are not forgotten.
